verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork documents delegating outcomes: 'describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work'. It takes on 'complex, multi-step tasks and execute[s] them on your behalf', and scheduled tasks can run automatically on a recurring basis or on demand, delivering finished reports. Research also works agentically over multiple searches. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of background autonomous runs, and explicit documentation of the review/approval step (notifications, reviewing results before they are applied).
